newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN MUNICH HELD BY LOWLY FREIBURG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN MUNICH HELD BY LOWLY FREIBURG.

text.p: Bundesliga leaders Bayern Munich were held to a shock 0-0 home draw by bottom club Freiburg on Saturday.
With only three weeks left in the title race, second-placed Bayer Leverkusen will move to within a point of Bayern if they beat Hamburg on Sunday.
It was the second draw in two weeks for Bayern, who have 64 points from 31 matches. Leverkusen have 60 from 30 games.
"Freiburg have done us a big favour," said Leverkusen coach Christoph Daum. "Now it is up to us to take advantage of that with a win on Sunday."
Third-placed Stuttgart failed to gain ground by losing 2-1 at Bochum. They trail Bayern by six points.
